atomicity.reason: One obligation: display remaining energy as the fuel tank level.

parent_fit.reason: Directly covers the 'know the remaining energy' half of US_RANGE_AWARENESS for a diesel vehicle by displaying the fuel tank level.

unambiguity.reason: Single reading: the remaining-energy indication is the fuel tank level.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by spelled-out not (var.powertrain.type == 'bev'), stronger than its ungated parent and exactly complementary to the BEV block of the same id.

verifiability.reason: Testable by comparing displayed and actual tank level, but unit/resolution and accuracy tolerance are not specified.
verifiability.suggestion: State the unit (e.g. % of tank or litres), resolution and the allowed deviation from the actual fuel level.
